text:
tara: Quick heads-up — ruby sampleapp shows a mismatch in retry behavior vs the python SDK. When token refresh races happen we return 401 immediately but python retries and recovers, so customers see intermittent auth errors.
lee: Which part of retry logic are you looking at? idempotent vs non-idempotent cases?
tara: It's in lib/redwood/http_client.rb -> #request. Current logic retries on 5xx and 429 with a fixed 1s sleep; it does NOT retry on 401 during a token-rotation race.
morgan: I thought we purposely didn't retry on 401 to avoid replaying non-idempotent requests. Are these transient 401s caused by token rotation?
tara: Yep. Flow is: background token refresher replaces token at T, concurrent requests that read old token get 401. Python SDK catches 401, triggers a refresh and retries once. Ruby bubbles 401 up.
alex: That sounds like a parity bug. We should align behavior: on 401 coming from auth failure, attempt a token refresh (thread-safe) and retry once, but avoid infinite retries.
lee: Can you open a PR?
tara: Started a branch: catch 401 -> attempt token refresh with a double-check and mutex, then retry once. Also switched 429/5xx to exponential backoff with jitter instead of fixed sleep. Added unit tests.
morgan: Be careful about blocking in Rack multi-threaded servers. A global mutex could stall other requests while refresh runs. Double-check locking is better.
tara: I implemented double-checked timestamp/versioning so the mutex is only acquired when refresh is actually needed; otherwise fast path is no-lock.
alex: Good. Add a tiny integration test that simulates concurrent requests during a forced refresh to ensure only one refresh call happens.
tara: Added a Minitest that spins 5 threads, forces refresh, asserts single refresh call, and that all requests succeed post-refresh.
ci-bot: CI queued: https://ci.redwood/sdk-ruby/9001 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ci-bot: CI passed: https://ci.redwood/sdk-ruby/9001 :white_check_mark:
lee: One nit on the PR: rename `refresh_mutex` to `token_refresh_mutex` and add a short comment explaining the double-check pattern.
tara: Updated per nits and pushed. Also added a Quickstart note: "SDKs may differ in default retry policies; if you need strict parity, set client retry options explicitly."
morgan: LGTM, will merge after one more review.
alex: Thanks all — this should cut down on support tickets for transient 401s. :thumbsup:
